caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher as the central object, rendered in grayscale pencil on a beige background. The pitcher features a bulbous body with a tapering base and a wide, flaring spout at the top. The pitcher has a thin, angular handle attached from the upper neck to the midpoint of the body. Decorative elements include a horizontal band of garland or floral motif encircling the upper part of the pitcher, as well as an emblem or crest enclosed within a leafy wreath on the front of the body. The crest appears to contain an eagle with outstretched wings above a shield that is divided into sections, with additional details in each section. The base of the pitcher has a subtle, ribbed texture. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset showing a simple outline of the pitcher with dimensions marked: 4 3/4 inches high, 3 inches wide at the widest point, and 1 3/4 inches at the base. In the lower right corner, another inset shows a close-up of the monogram "MS" surrounded by a laurel wreath. The overall composition centers the pitcher, with the two inset drawings providing additional technical and decorative information. All elements are drawn in shades of gray, with clear, precise lines detailing the forms and ornaments.
title: Silver Creamer
